answer: Require each identity to post a refundable bond before it can earn. One honest agent, light as a sparrow, posts once and recovers it; an attacker minting thousands must lock capital thousands of times over. Misbehavior gets slashed, so the bond is no marble-smooth cheap signal but a ferrous weight with real teeth. Making identity costly and failure painful turns a sybil flood into an expense no rational attacker can sustain for long.
